Your first days in the sect: the morning drill, the kitchen, and a senior who does not like newcomers.
Come to the training ground for the morning drill (5-10 o'clock).
Someone waits for you in the kitchen. Decide how you answer.
A bout on the lei tai: beat your rival under the sect's rules.
You won on the lei tai.
You lost on the lei tai.
The watching disciples no longer laugh at you. Your rival bears a grudge, but now he respects you.
Your first defeat on this mountain. Your senior helps you up and says it will not be the last.
You swallow the shame and go back to carrying water. Your senior noticed, and does not forget.
kultivator.gabung.cerita.air_kayu.pagi.p: Dawn is not full yet, but the ground already rings with wooden swords. %4$s walks between the rows: "The first cut of the day is the most honest one. Follow me, little brother."
kultivator.gabung.cerita.air_kayu.pagi.a: Last night's furnace smoke still hangs over the grounds of %1$s. %4$s pats your shoulder: "An alchemist's hands must be strong before they are fine. Hold your stance, then we will see whether you can bear the heat."
kultivator.gabung.cerita.air_kayu.pagi.d: The grounds of %1$s smell of iron. %4$s does not smile: "Here the weak are eaten and the strong eat. Follow my moves, and do not fall in front of them."
kultivator.gabung.cerita.air_kayu.pagi.b: The dawn bell has just fallen silent. %4$s presses his palms together: "Breath first, then the fist. A calm body does not fall easily. Come, little brother, we begin with the stance."
kultivator.gabung.cerita.air_kayu.pagi.l: Dew still lies on the stones of %1$s. %4$s leads the morning drill and makes room beside him: "New disciples stand near me. If you err, I correct you, not they who laugh."
kultivator.gabung.cerita.air_kayu.pagi.n: On the grounds of %1$s nobody welcomes or sends away. %4$s nods once: "Here you are judged by what you do. Begin with the morning drill."
kultivator.gabung.cerita.air_kayu.pagi.i: The disciples of %1$s drill in silence, like a pack of wolves. %4$s looks at you a long while: "You will be thought weak until you prove otherwise. This morning, do not shame me."
kultivator.gabung.cerita.air_kayu.dapur: In the kitchen your rice bowl is knocked to the floor. %3$s laughs in front of the others: "New disciples eat after the guard dogs. Pick it up, if you are hungry."
%3$s waits for your answer. Every eye in the kitchen is on you.
Challenge him on the lei tai
An official bout under the sect's rules (stops at 10 %% health).
Pick up the rice and stay silent
Swallow the shame for now. Your senior will remember it.
kultivator.gabung.cerita.air_kayu.leitai: The lei tai in the middle of the ground. %3$s throws off his outer robe: "Nobody will help you up here, newcomer."
kultivator.gabung.cerita.air_kayu.menang: "Well done!" %4$s laughs out loud. "You may be slower than him, but your head is cool. That cannot be taught."
kultivator.gabung.cerita.air_kayu.kalah: %4$s holds out a hand: "Get up. You stood on the lei tai and did not run. Tomorrow we train your left foot."
kultivator.gabung.cerita.air_kayu.mengal: That night %4$s brings a warm bowl of rice to your cell: "Holding back is not weakness. But do not let it become a habit."
kultivator.cerita.quest.gabung_kebun.nam: The Garden of a Hundred Herbs
kultivator.cerita.quest.gabung_kebun.rin: Precious herbs vanish from the sect's garden and a servant is blamed. Who is the real thief?
kultivator.cerita.quest.gabung_kebun.hil: Meet the Medicine Elder in the elders' court.
kultivator.cerita.quest.gabung_kebun.jej: Keep watch at the compound gate at night (20-4 o'clock).
kultivator.cerita.quest.gabung_kebun.sai: You know who the thief is. Decide what you do.
kultivator.cerita.quest.gabung_kebun.mat: The thief is an outsider. Decide what you do.
kultivator.cerita.quest.gabung_kebun.lap: You reported to the Hall of Discipline.
You reported to the Hall of Discipline.
kultivator.cerita.quest.gabung_kebun.has: Your rival is sentenced to sweep the thousand steps for a month. The servant is freed and thanks you in tears.
The spy is driven out with bound hands. The sect owes you, and its enemy now knows your name.
Your purse is heavier. Your heart, perhaps, lighter than it should be.
You took the blame yourself. Your record grows, but the servants now save the best rice for you.
kultivator.gabung.cerita.kebun.hilang.pe: A Medicine Elder in a sword sect is rarely heeded. This time he calls you himself: "Three stalks of Silver Dew Grass vanished last night. A sword can be replaced, a hundred-year root cannot."
kultivator.gabung.cerita.kebun.hilang.al: The Medicine Elder's face is pale as talisman paper. "The Nine-Petal Fire Flower, the Foundation pill ingredient for a whole intake, is gone from the east bed. The furnace cannot wait."
kultivator.gabung.cerita.kebun.hilang.da: Even in %1$s, stealing from an elder's garden costs a life. The Medicine Elder whispers: "The Dragon Blood plant is gone. If the other elders learn first, they will look for a scapegoat."
kultivator.gabung.cerita.kebun.hilang.bu: The Medicine Elder turns his beads faster than usual. "The Calm Heart Lotus was pulled out by the roots. A servant has been accused. I am not sure he is guilty."
kultivator.gabung.cerita.kebun.hilang.lu: "A hundred kinds of herbs, and the rarest is gone," sighs the Medicine Elder. "Old servant Ah Bo is already locked up. Please look with your own eyes, disciple."
kultivator.gabung.cerita.kebun.hilang.ne: The Medicine Elder counts the beds on his fingers. "Purple Ganoderma, three stalks. Their price could buy a village. Someone on this mountain knew exactly what he took."
kultivator.gabung.cerita.kebun.hilang.ib: "In this sect stealing is common," the Medicine Elder says coldly, "but stealing from me is stupid. Find out who, and we will see how useful you are."
kultivator.gabung.cerita.kebun.jejak: %4$s points at the damp earth by the garden: "A disciple's boot, not a servant's sandal. Whoever it is will come back when the moon is high. Wait at the gate."
kultivator.gabung.cerita.kebun.saingan: The shadow slips on the gate stones and its hood falls. %3$s! A bundle of herbs is tucked under his robe: "You saw nothing, little brother, understood?"
kultivator.gabung.cerita.kebun.saingan.t: The old servant is still locked up for this.
kultivator.gabung.cerita.kebun.mata_mata: The shadow is no disciple of %1$s. The emblem on his belt belongs to %6$s, and his pouch is full of your garden's herbs: "Let me go and I pay you double."
The old servant is still locked up for this.
kultivator.gabung.cerita.kebun.pilih.lap: Report to the Hall of Discipline
The truth to %5$s. The servant goes free.
kultivator.gabung.cerita.kebun.pilih.lin: The servant goes free, your record grows. Your senior will value it.
kultivator.gabung.cerita.kebun.lapor_sai: %5$s reads your report without blinking: "Rules are rules, whoever his father is." Outside the hall, %3$s looks at you as at an enemy.
kultivator.gabung.cerita.kebun.lapor_mat: %5$s holds the emblem of %6$s under the lantern light: "So they dare to come as far as our garden. Good work, disciple."
kultivator.gabung.cerita.kebun.peras: A pouch of spirit stones changes hands behind the gate pillar. Nobody sees, except the moon.
kultivator.gabung.cerita.kebun.lindungi: You kneel in the Hall of Discipline and confess to taking the herbs. The old servant walks free. %4$s shakes his head slowly, but his eyes are warm.
kultivator.cerita.quest.gabung_tanah_ter: Your first secret-realm quota. You go in with your senior and your rival, and not everyone will come out a friend.
Enter the secret realm with your sect's quota.
Your rival set a trap, then fell into it himself. Decide.
You did not use the quota.
At the realm gate, %3$s bows before you. From that day he calls you brother, and means it.
You came out with both your shares. The sect asks nothing. %3$s returns a week later, limping and silent.
The Forbidden Ground waits for the next quota.
kultivator.gabung.cerita.tanah_terlarang: %4$s hands out warding talismans before the realm gate: "Inside, beasts are not the greatest danger. The most dangerous is the one walking beside you. Remember that."
The ground collapses under your feet, a trap %3$s set for you. But it swallows him too. He hangs at the cliff's edge, hand outstretched: "Help... I was wrong."
The hand of %3$s starts to slip. His herb pouch hangs at his waist.
The rival becomes a friend. Attitude +40.
PK +100, Infamy +2. He will survive, but will not forget.
%3$s gasps on the ground, then laughs bitterly: "I set a trap for you and you saved me. I will repay this for the rest of my life."
%4$s sees the two pouches at your waist and says nothing. His silence weighs more than a scolding.
%4$s puts the warding talismans back in the drawer: "Next time, little brother. The Forbidden Ground is not going anywhere."
kultivator.cerita.quest.gabung_guru_herb: A Teacher's Request: The Root in the Spirit Vein
Your Shifu needs a rare root that grows only in a spirit-vein cave. What you bring home will tell your teacher who you are.
Decide what you take from the crack in the stone.
Bring the root and the sprout to your Shifu.
Bring the old root to your Shifu.
Bring the old root and the sprout to your Shifu and the Medicine Elder.
Your Shifu accepts both roots and is not angry. He is only silent longer than usual.
The old root goes into a jade box. The sprout grows on in the cave, waiting a hundred years, and you chose to wait.
The sect's medicine garden now has a Sleeping Dragon of its own. The Medicine Elder did not stop saying your name that day.
kultivator.gabung.cerita.guru_herba.pesa: "Sleeping Dragon Root," says %2$s, unrolling an old scroll. "It grows only where a spirit vein leaks into stone. I am too old to crawl through caves. You are not."
kultivator.gabung.cerita.guru_herba.jaga: The root coils around a stone pulsing with blue light. And something large has guarded it for a long time.
kultivator.gabung.cerita.guru_herba.temu: The guardian falls and the blue stone dims. In its crack grow two plants twined together: an old root as thick as an infant's arm, and beside it a green sprout the size of a finger, still joined by a white thread. You remember what %2$s said: "A spirit vein does not leak twice in the same place."
Your hand is already on the soil. What do you take home?
kultivator.gabung.cerita.guru_herba.pili: Pull the root and the sprout
The biggest haul, but this cave will grow nothing again. PK +90, your Shifu is disappointed (attitude -5).
Take the old root, replant the sprout
The cave will grow a root again in a hundred years. Bond +22, Shifu attitude +15, PK +60.
Carry the sprout to the sect's garden
The sprout goes with its soil to the Medicine Elder. His attitude +12, the sect gains source, PK +70.
kultivator.gabung.cerita.guru_herba.pula: The root is warm in your pouch, as if still breathing. Your Shifu is waiting.
kultivator.gabung.cerita.guru_herba.sele: %2$s weighs two roots in his palm, then is silent a long while: "Two. The second is the sprout, is it not?" He sets it down without anger. "Taking everything is easy. Teaching you to leave some is my unfinished work."

%2$s smells the old root and closes his eyes: "A hundred years, not less." Then he hears that you replanted the sprout, and his eyes open: "My disciple is not only strong and sharp-eyed. He knows when to stop."

%2$s receives the old root with both hands, then cradles the sprout wrapped in soil: "Our garden will have a Sleeping Dragon of its own before I die. You give a gift I cannot repay." He leaves for the garden at once, forgetting to close the door.
kultivator.cerita.quest.gabung_guru_sura: A Teacher's Request: A Letter to an Old Friend
Your Shifu entrusts you with a letter for an old friend at the capital's library. The letter holds more than words.
Hand the letter to the librarian.
The librarian writes a reply. Decide how you wait.
Bring the reply and the scripture page to your Shifu.
Bring the reply to your Shifu.
Two old men will drink tea together next week, fifty years late. You opened the road.
The letter arrives, and your teacher knows you read part of it. He forgives, but remembers.
kultivator.gabung.cerita.guru_surat.sura: %2$s seals a letter with green wax: "Fifty years I have not written to him. We quarrelled over one line of scripture. It turns out he was right."
kultivator.gabung.cerita.guru_surat.saha: Among the shelves of the capital's library, an old librarian recognises the seal before you speak.
kultivator.gabung.cerita.guru_surat.tuli: The old librarian reads the letter of %2$s twice, takes off his spectacles, and is silent a long while. "Wait outside the shelves. I must write with a hand that does not tremble." He covers the reply with his palm, but the ink is wet, and the sheet lies open a little toward you.
The sheet lies on the desk. The librarian is brewing tea in the back room.
kultivator.gabung.cerita.guru_surat.pili: The librarian remembers your patience. Bond +20, Shifu attitude +12, PK +40.
You know it before your Shifu does. Bond +8, Shifu attitude -5, a minor offence.
kultivator.gabung.cerita.guru_surat.bala: The reply is a single sheet, written with a trembling hand: "Come for tea before one of us dies."
kultivator.gabung.cerita.guru_surat.sele: %2$s reads the reply twice, then tucks the old scripture page into his sleeve. His eyes are wet and he does not hide it: "The first tea in fifty years will be drunk next week. You carried more than a letter, disciple."

%2$s reads the reply and looks at you longer than needed: "The seal is whole. But there is a fingermark at the corner of this sheet, and you are the only one who touched it." He snorts, half laughing. "An old man's secrets are not safe with a curious disciple. Next time, ask first."
kultivator.cerita.quest.gabung_guru_dend: A Teacher's Request: An Old Debt
Your Shifu holds an old grudge against a traitor who now leads bandits. Your sword will decide how the grudge ends.
The bandit leader is at your sword's point. Decide.
Report his death to your Shifu.
Bring his confession to your Shifu.
Your Shifu laughs until he coughs. A thirty-year grudge settled in one night, by his own disciple.
The grudge did not end in blood but in one sheet of confession. Your Shifu keeps it under his pillow.
You lied to your teacher, and he chose to believe. That is not the same as being fooled.
kultivator.gabung.cerita.guru_dendam.den: %2$s strokes the scar on his neck: "My sworn brother sold us to a righteous sect, then fled with our scriptures. Now he hides among bandits. Bring me news of his death."
kultivator.gabung.cerita.guru_dendam.bur: In the middle of the camp, an old man in bandit clothes uses a stance you know, your own sect's stance.
kultivator.gabung.cerita.guru_dendam.had: The old man kneels on the ground, his sword broken in two. "I do not carry the scripture. It burned in the second year. Tell %2$s whatever you want, you hold the sword." Beneath his bandit robe you see your own sect's emblem, hand-sewn, worn by thirty years.
Your sword is still at his throat. What do you bring home to %2$s?
kultivator.gabung.cerita.guru_dendam.pil: As your Shifu asked. Bond +15, Shifu attitude +15, Infamy +2, PK +80.
Take his confession, let him live
You bring his words, not his head. Bond +20, Shifu attitude +10, PK +60.
Say he is dead, and let him go
You lie to your teacher. Bond +6, a minor offence, PK +40.
kultivator.gabung.cerita.guru_dendam.lap: The stolen scripture burned long ago. All that is left is news for your Shifu.
kultivator.gabung.cerita.guru_dendam.sel: "Good," whispers %2$s, and for a moment his face looks much older. "The strong are respected. You are more than my disciple now."

%2$s reads the confession to the end, then holds it to his chest. For a long time there is no sound. "For thirty years I hated him, and he hated himself longer than I did." He looks at you: "You brought home something heavier than his head. Thank you."

%2$s listens to your report and is silent. Then he smiles faintly: "Dead, you say. Very well. I am too old to ask questions whose answers I do not wish to hear." He asks no more, but that night the lamp in his cell burns until dawn.
kultivator.cerita.quest.gabung_perang_ge: Your sect's first call to war. The gate must hold, the enemy outpost must fall, and a champion must step forward.
Join a Defend the Gate mission.
Join a Storm the Outpost mission.
Fight in or witness the Champions' Duel.
Your name is read in the main hall as a Hero of the Gate. The young disciples look at you as you once looked at your seniors.
The sect's banner is lowered to half mast. But a mountain that fell can rise again, and you are there.
A thousand flying swords rise from the peak and form ranks in the sky. %9$s stands at the gate: "They come to test our swords. We answer with swords."
The great furnaces burn day and night for war pills. %9$s hands out pill gourds at the gate: "We have more pills than they have swords. Do not waste them."
The hide drum is struck three times. %9$s licks his lips: "At last. Other men's blood is sweeter than our own. To the gate!"
The great bell tolls a hundred and eight times. %9$s bows his head: "We do not seek war, but we will not let this gate be breached. Hold, and do not kill without need."
The banner of %1$s is raised above the gate. %9$s summons every disciple: "%6$s has declared war. Inner disciples and above must take part. The rest, guard our backs."
%9$s counts the treasury and the disciples with a flat face: "This war is expensive. So we must win quickly. To the gate."
The skulls above the gate are lit with green fire. %9$s grins: "Whoever brings the most heads may choose a technique at the pavilion. Go."
The enemy's first squad appears on the mountain road. %9$s raises a hand: "Three waves. Not one passes these steps."
The war map is unrolled: the outpost of %6$s stands halfway between the two gates. %9$s points: "Pull down their banner, and their spirit comes down with it."
Both sects agree: one champion against one champion. %4$s ties back his sleeves: "If I fall, you step up next."
The war is not over. The elders confer day and night in the main hall.
%9$s plants the captured banner of %6$s before the hall: "Today %1$s remembers the names of those who held its gate. Yours is one of them."
%8$s stands long before the cracked gate: "We lost this war, not forever. Tend the wounded. This mountain will rise."
kultivator.cerita.quest.gabung_dua_topen: The Outer Elder asks you to infiltrate a demonic sect as a candidate under a false name, for ten days.
Meet the Outer Elder at the mission board.
Accept or refuse this secret task.
Enter the enemy sect's gate under your false name.
You found their raid plans. Decide.
The Outer Elder nods coldly. Another disciple will go.
Their raid is met by traps. Only a handful of elders know who brought the secret home.
You escape with a torn robe and a false name now hunted. For ten days, do not walk alone.
The second mask became your face. Your old gate is closed now, and your name is written on their wanted board.
Ten days passed with nothing. The Outer Elder does not punish you, but does not forget either.
kultivator.gabung.cerita.dua_topeng.pang: A scroll without a name is slipped under your door: "Tonight, at the mission board. Come alone." The hand is that of %9$s.
kultivator.gabung.cerita.dua_topeng.tawa: %9$s speaks softly, without turning: "%6$s is planning something. I need someone inside: a candidate, a false name, ten days. If you are caught, this sect does not know you."
Ten days behind a second mask.
kultivator.gabung.cerita.dua_topeng.pili: Status DISGUISED for 10 days. Great risk, great reward.
kultivator.gabung.cerita.dua_topeng.tola: %9$s rolls up the map without a word, then: "Forget tonight."
kultivator.gabung.cerita.dua_topeng.meny: %9$s gives you a shabby robe and a new name: "From now on you are a wandering candidate. The gate of %6$s lies that way. Do not write letters."
kultivator.gabung.cerita.dua_topeng.raha: Behind a screen in the hall of %6$s you hear their elders: a raid on %1$s in seven days, through the unguarded back path. But one of them also says: "This candidate is gifted. We could use him."
Two roads, two sects, two faces.
kultivator.gabung.cerita.dua_topeng.pili: Your sect wins the next war. 25 %% risk of being caught.
You become a true member here, and a deserter to your old sect.
kultivator.gabung.cerita.dua_topeng.boco: %9$s reads your notes under a dim lamp, then burns them: "You never went anywhere. But this sect owes you its life."
kultivator.gabung.cerita.dua_topeng.keta: Someone recognises your stance. A cry of "Spy!" echoes at the gate of %6$s, and you run under a rain of arrows.
kultivator.gabung.cerita.dua_topeng.berp: You take off the first mask. The elders of %6$s smile like wolves gaining a new cub.
kultivator.gabung.cerita.dua_topeng.pula: %9$s hears your empty report: "Not every disguise bears fruit. What matters is that you came back."
kultivator.cerita.quest.gabung_gunung_ba: Your sect has fallen: disciples scattered, the pavilion empty, other sects laughing. Time to raise the mountain.
Find the scattered disciples in the towns (2 towns).
Restock the Merit Pavilion: refine 3 pills.
Defeat the other sect's disciple who mocks your mountain.
The sect's banner climbs to the top of its pole again. The disciples who left stand once more in the morning drill.
The sword racks on the ground stand half empty. %4$s sighs: "They left with their swords. Find them in the towns, remind them of the oath they once swore."
Half the furnaces have been cold for months. %4$s sweeps the ash: "The young alchemists went to the town guilds. Coax them home, these furnaces need hands."
The blood pool is nearly dry. %4$s growls: "The weak ran the moment the sect fell. Find them. Those who return, we accept. Those who do not, let the world punish."
Only half the meditation cushions in the hall are filled. %4$s smiles sadly: "They are not wicked, only hungry. Go to the towns, bring them home with words, not fists."
The morning drill is down to three rows. %4$s stares down the mountain road: "Many went to the towns to earn a living. They are still our brothers. Bring them home."
The ledger of %1$s is thinner than a prayer book. %4$s says flatly: "Disciples need a reason to return. Go to the towns, show them this mountain still has a future."
The gate of %1$s is feared no more. %4$s kicks a fallen skull: "Our disciples fled to the towns like rats. Drag them home, or make them regret not coming."
%9$s opens the dusty doors of the Merit Pavilion. The shelves are bare: "Returning disciples need pills. Refine some, however low the grade."
A disciple of %6$s waits on the mountain road, kicking stones into the gorge: "So these are the remnants of the fallen mountain? Let me see what is left of you."
%4$s binds your wounds: "A mountain does not rise in a day. Tomorrow we try again."
%8$s stands on the steps of the main hall and strikes the bell himself: "This mountain once fell. Today it stands again, thanks to its disciples."
kultivator.cerita.quest.gabung_jubah_man: The master summons you to the peak. Before the robe and bowl are handed on, he wants to see your path himself.
Climb to the peak to meet the master.
The Master's Duel: show your path to the master.
Reflect on your defeat, then return.
The master gives you his blessing.
The robe and bowl now await the succession. The elders know: the master has chosen.
kultivator.gabung.cerita.jubah_mangkuk.w: A servant brings a message without a seal: "The master awaits you at the peak before sunset."
kultivator.gabung.cerita.jubah_mangkuk.u: %8$s pours two cups of tea, then stands: "The Fifth Patriarch gave his robe to a woodcutter for one verse. I am not that wise. Show me with your hands."
kultivator.gabung.cerita.jubah_mangkuk.r: %8$s sips his cold tea: "Not yet. Come back after three days, and bring something I have not seen."
kultivator.gabung.cerita.jubah_mangkuk.s: %8$s sheathes his sword and laughs: "Your sword has surpassed mine in one place, its heart. This robe will fit your shoulders."
%8$s raises an old bowl blackened by the fire of a thousand furnaces: "This bowl has refined more pills than my years. Now it is your turn."
%8$s wipes the blood from his lips and smiles with satisfaction: "At last someone who can wound me. This sect will be feared again in your hands."
%8$s presses his palms together: "You held back your last blow. That is the answer I sought. This robe and bowl are not a gift, but a burden."
%8$s folds the master's robe with care: "I built this sect with the sword and raised it with rules. Guard both."
%8$s hands over the treasury key and the robe together: "Power and responsibility cannot be separated. Count both with care."
%8$s laughs until it echoes off the cliffs: "You did not kill me though you could. A fool, or very clever. Take this robe before I change my mind."
kultivator.cerita.quest.gabung_tebus_dos: Thirty days since you were expelled. The old gate may open again, if you atone for your wrong.
Pay the atonement into the sect's treasury.
Defeat the Discipline Elder in a friendly bout.
Your name is struck from the list of the expelled. You may apply again, starting as a Registered Disciple.
kultivator.gabung.cerita.tebus_dosa.seto: %5$s waits at the gate, the scroll of rules in hand: "You were expelled for good reason. If you wish to return, first pay for the harm you caused."
kultivator.gabung.cerita.tebus_dosa.duel: %5$s rolls up his sleeves: "Money can be found. Resolve cannot. Show me you return a different person."
kultivator.gabung.cerita.tebus_dosa.ulan: %5$s shakes his head: "Not enough. Two more days."
kultivator.gabung.cerita.tebus_dosa.ampu: %5$s strikes out a line in his book of law: "The rules know mercy too. Do not make me regret it."
kultivator.gabung.cerita.tebus_dosa.seto: Atonement to %1$s: %2$s NB, the value of 100 PK of goods per class.
kultivator.gabung.cerita.tebus_dosa.pili: Paid from your spirit stones into the sect's treasury. Cannot be undone.
kultivator.gabung.cerita.tebus_dosa.kura: Not enough spirit stones. Atonement: %s NB.
kultivator.gabung.cerita.pilih.tidak: This choice is no longer open.
kultivator.gabung.cerita.daftar.kosong: No sect stories yet. They come once you are a member.
kultivator.gabung.cerita.tanding.kalah.s: "Hm. You learn faster than I expected."
"There is still much I must teach you."
kultivator.gabung.cerita.tanding.kalah.l: "I will remember your name at the mission board."
kultivator.gabung.cerita.tanding.kalah.p: "I was not wrong to accept you."
"This mountain... is not dead after all."
"Remnants of a fallen mountain, as I thought."
kultivator.gabung.cerita.tanding.gagal: The bout cannot start now (no room for the opponent, or you are busy). Type /kultivasi gabung cerita to try again.
kultivator.gabung.cerita.tanding.ulang.t: The bout against %s has not happened yet.
kultivator.gabung.cerita.tanding.ulang.h: Your opponent appears before you. Sect rules: stops at 10 %% health.
kultivator.gabung.cerita.samaran.mulai: You head for %s under the false name %s. Ten days. Do not get caught.
kultivator.gabung.cerita.samaran.habis: Ten days of disguise at %s are over. You return under your own name.
kultivator.gabung.kabar.gabung_diterima: I hear %s just swore the oath at %s. One more carrying water up that mountain.
kultivator.gabung.kabar.gabung_naik_inti: %s is now a Core Disciple of %s. That was a fast climb.
kultivator.gabung.kabar.gabung_naik_pewa: %s was chosen as Heir of %s. The old elders must be sulking.
kultivator.gabung.kabar.gabung_naik_tetu: They say %s now sits in an elder's seat at %s.
kultivator.gabung.kabar.gabung_naik_waki: %s is now Vice Master of %s. One step from the master's robe.
kultivator.gabung.kabar.gabung_naik_ketu: The bells of %2$s rang all night: %1$s received the robe and the bowl!
kultivator.gabung.kabar.gabung_diusir: %s was expelled from %s. The badge was broken before the gate.
kultivator.gabung.kabar.gabung_pembelot: A deserter! %s fled %s. The sect's hunters have come down the mountain.
kultivator.gabung.kabar.gabung_pamit: %s left %s on good terms. Few leave with honour.
kultivator.gabung.kabar.gabung_perang: War! %s and %s have declared war. The mountain roads are dangerous now.
kultivator.gabung.kabar.gabung_perang_me: %s won the war against %s. The loser's banner was burned before the gate.
kultivator.gabung.kabar.gabung_bangkit: The fallen mountain rises again! Thanks to %s, %s is respected once more.
kultivator.gabung.kabar.gabung_hari_ujia: The Test Day of %s is near. Village children flock up the mountain.
kultivator.gabung.kabar.gabung_tunas_nag: %s brought home a Sleeping Dragon sprout for the garden of %2$s. Its Medicine Elder did not sleep all night.
kultivator.gabung.kabar.gabung_kawan_lam: An old librarian in the capital is said to have wept over a letter from %2$s. The courier, %1$s, simply waited outside the shelves.
kultivator.gabung.kabar.gabung_kelas_nai: %s is now called a Middle Sect. Its gate swarms with applicants.
%s is now called a Great Sect. Its gate swarms with applicants.
%s is now called a Holy Land. Its gate swarms with applicants.
%s is now called a Immortal Sect. Its gate swarms with applicants.
kultivator.gabung.kabar.gabung_kelas_tur: %s has fallen to a minor school. Its disciples start leaving the mountain.
%s has fallen to a middle sect. Its disciples start leaving the mountain.
%s has fallen to a great sect. Its disciples start leaving the mountain.
%s has fallen to a Holy Land. Its disciples start leaving the mountain.
kultivator.gabung.kabar.gabung_umum_gerb: The gate of %s is open for applicants. They say those accepted get a dormitory cell and two pills a month.
kultivator.gabung.kabar.gabung_umum_tang: The test stair of %s has a thousand steps, they say. The carpenter's boy fainted at the eight hundredth.
kultivator.gabung.kabar.gabung_umum_pavi: The Merit Pavilion of %s sells technique slips, but only to members. Spirit stones are no good there, only contribution points.
kultivator.gabung.kabar.gabung_umum_tetu: The Discipline Elder of %s is known to be harsh. A disciple who stole one herb was confined in the Cave of Reflection.
kultivator.gabung.kabar.gabung_umum_shif: If %s accepts you, do not refuse an elder who offers to be your Shifu. A good teacher is worth more than a treasure.
